description: cmux MCP server widget tools (tools.schema.json). acpmux accepts exactly the valid inputs; the server lists exactly the four widget tools. No input can request or grant a capability: a capability is a separate gesture-gated request from the rendered widget (bridge.schema.json, cmux/cap/request).
